remarks: This 3,162 square foot ground floor retail space is strategically situated in a high-traffic area, making it ideal for businesses seeking visibility and accessibility and located in the South Norwalk (SoNo) district, an area known for its historical charm and bustling commercial activity. Just a few step away from Restaurants, Bars, Maritime Aquarium, Oyster Shell Park, Movie Theater, Food Market, Sport Facilities. Close proximity to the SONO Collection Mall, Norwalk's Beaches, All Major Highways and Metro North Train Station.
